changelog: Fixed in-place updates: every release is now signed with one persistent keystore, so new versions install over the existing app instead of failing with 'App not installed as package appears to be invalid'
Note: this one release changes the signing key, so uninstall the old app once and then install 1.0.19; all later updates will install normally
Includes restored proot/loader binaries (1.0.18) and the hub startup/restart/CSRF fixes (1.0.17)
